sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Ball Vs Beat are simple yet addictive. To play, you'll need to tap the screen to slide the ball in and out of a line, hitting all the notes in perfect rhythm. The game has three main gameplay modes: Time Attack, Survival, and Practice. In Time Attack mode, you'll need to hit all the notes in a set amount of time to earn the highest score. In Survival mode, you'll need to hit all the notes to survive as long as possible. In Practice mode, you can practice your skills and learn new songs.

   One of the key features of Ball Vs Beat is its note system. The game has different types of notes, including single notes, double notes, and triple notes. Each type of note has its own point value and difficulty level, making it challenging to hit all the notes perfectly. The game also has power-ups and collectibles that you can earn by hitting all the notes perfectly. These power-ups and collectibles can help you unlock new songs and improve your skills.

   The game's physics engine is also worth noting. The ball's movement is smooth and realistic, making it feel like you're actually playing a musical instrument. The game's sound design is also excellent, with realistic sound effects and music that's catchy and upbeat. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Ball Vs Beat are simple yet addictive, making it a game that you won't want to put down.
